problemsFound.problem: H1/JSON-LD headline '问题反复出现。领导者的系统思维。' used a full stop as the internal beat separator and carried a trailing full stop; both are banned on headlines (zh-register.md rule 27: beats separated by a space or 　, never a period; no trailing full stop).
problemsFound.fix: Changed to '问题反复出现 领导者的系统思维' (space-separated beats, 14 characters, no trailing period) in both the H1 and the JSON-LD headline field.

problemsFound.problem: The page named the literal term '仆人式领导（servant leadership）' twice (lede and body), but the English source page (src/app/(en)/insights/systems-thinking-for-leaders/page.tsx) never names 'servant leadership' literally — it only uses 'serves'/'serving' as posture language. Spec section 6 also restricts naming the literal term to /how-it-works or the guide introduction. Naming it here is both an unlicensed addition beyond the English source and a second site-wide occurrence of a term meant to be named once.
problemsFound.fix: Removed both occurrences of the named term, replacing them with the same 'serves the people inside the structure' posture language the English page uses, without naming servant leadership: lede now reads '……服务的正是身处其中的人。'; body now reads '……对结构负责的领导者，服务的是身处结构之中、必须在其中做事的人，而不只是发号施令。'

problemsFound.problem: Body sentence used the hedge word '往往' ('第一个答案往往一目了然'), an undefined-norm violation.
problemsFound.fix: Replaced with '立刻' (removes the unsupported generalisation while keeping the meaning).

problemsFound.problem: CtaSection heading '把它用在您现在正权衡的决定上。' carried a trailing period, contained the pronoun 您, and at 14 characters (excluding 您) was at the edge of the limit once the pronoun and filler were removed.
problemsFound.fix: Shortened to '用在眼下正权衡的决定上' (11 characters, no trailing period, no pronoun).

ownerQuestions: This unit's own writer handback flagged the servant-leadership naming as something to confirm with the reviewer; on review, it is removed because the English source for this specific page does not name the term and spec section 6 limits the literal naming to /how-it-works or the guide introduction — flagging to the owner in case the intent was instead to update spec section 6 to permit naming it on additional insights pages.
